name: @guilospanck/modelgen
description: Procedural 3D models from code: mesh + SDF sculpting, painted textures, USDZ and glTF/GLB export, cosmetic anchors, idle-animation shaders. Zero dependencies.
author: Guilherme Pereira

scripts.example: node cli.js build examples --out out --format usdz,glb && node cli.js render examples --out out && node cli.js anchors examples --config examples/anchors.config.json --out out/anchors.json && node cli.js life examples --config examples/life.config.json --anchors out/anchors.json --out out/life.json --previews out
